purpose: Mechanical relationship scan. It finds conditional patterns only; AI and private trading logic decide whether a hypothesis is useful.
leakage_guard: Each condition uses only market/context/flow data available at or before the price timestamp.

conditions.news_and_polymarket: News Risk and Polymarket volume spike happen together.
conditions.risk_on_and_context: Risk-On and Market Context are both supportive.
conditions.macro_and_flow: Macro Risk and Flow Alert are elevated together.
